decision: The 337.5-to-000 loop seam is repaired, but a conspicuous head-orientation step remains immediately before it at 315-to-337.5. No other visual blocker was found.
method: Reviewed the refreshed native boundary sheet, all sixteen ordered full-body looks and their head crops, the complete state contact sheet, motion stills, and a native strip cropped directly from the hashed final encoded sheet. This is a visual judgment; no numeric continuity thresholds were used for acceptance. The animated GIF was not viewed as motion.

blockers.evidence: At 192 by 208 native cell size, 315 remains a strong left three-quarter upward head with a prominent side ear/rosette arrangement and an offset cheek/nose. The 337.5 head abruptly becomes almost frontal, with a symmetric two-eye face and centered chin. The stationary torso makes that head pivot conspicuous. The following 337.5-to-000 change is now small; the large left-to-front step is therefore concentrated one cell earlier rather than distributed through the final upper-left directions.
blockers.smallest_source_repair: Repair the 315 source head/upper neck into an intermediate left-up three-quarter view between 292.5 and the new 337.5, reducing the side turn while keeping the upward gaze. Keep the existing body, feet, wings, robe, tail, overall scale, and anatomical-left rosette attachment. Re-encode the repaired complete source row without altering the accepted 337.5-to-000 relationship.

337.5_to_000.evidence: Now a near-frontal upward face followed by a slightly stronger upward tilt. Minor face-width and silhouette change is visible, but this boundary no longer has the former conspicuous profile-to-front snap or a whole-pet size pop.

157.5_to_180.evidence: The change to the centered bowed head reads as a natural neighboring tilt; body and feet remain registered.

315_to_337.5.evidence: Large left-three-quarter to near-frontal head pivot remains conspicuous at native size.

other_adjacent_looks.evidence: Angular spacing is not perfectly uniform, but the other transitions keep a credible ordered direction change without another conspicuous identity, body-scale, or registration break.

character_identity_and_rendering.evidence: The same white/lavender-haired horned character and fine pale rendering remain recognizable across all actions and looks.

head_body_proportions_and_practical_scal.evidence: Standing figures retain a consistent practical height and body footprint relative to neutral. The repaired last head is somewhat narrower than 000, but its change into the stronger upward tilt is not a separate conspicuous size-pop blocker.

wings_tail_and_robe.evidence: All retain coherent design and attachment; no isolated detached part is visible.

body_and_feet_registration.evidence: Standing looks retain their torso/foot placement. Running and jumping changes read as action poses.

rosette_anatomical_left.evidence: The ornament remains physically attached at anatomical left; right-facing occlusion is plausible.

clipping_and_holes.evidence: No conspicuous clipped extremity or accidental transparent hole is visible.

cardinals_and_direction_order.evidence: Up, right, down, and left remain clear, and all four quadrants are represented in the expected order. The outstanding defect is transition spacing in the final upper-left quadrant.
